purpose: Separate prediction quality from ticket construction so a high hit rate or headline payout cannot hide the cost of many combinations.
core_principle: The prediction model and ticket-expression layer are evaluated separately.
Every candidate buying structure is defined before result access.
No ticket structure may be selected retrospectively because it happened to win.
Abstention is a valid action when no structure clears its future authorized edge rule.

structures.combinations_formula: 3 * (field_size - 2), assuming fixed first is not in the second group

primary_comparison.name: FIXED_TOTAL_RACE_RISK
primary_comparison.rule: Each race receives the same total research risk budget; if a structure has multiple combinations, the budget is split across those combinations.
primary_comparison.reason: Prevents a 24-point or 60-point structure from appearing better merely because much more stake was deployed.

secondary_replication.name: FIXED_UNIT_PER_COMBINATION
secondary_replication.rule: Also report what happens under equal stake per combination, with total race stake explicitly shown.
secondary_replication.reason: Matches how many real-world advertised or published ticket examples are naturally interpreted, but must not be mixed with the primary denominator.

future_metrics_when_authorized: largest single hit share of total profit
advertisement_claim_audit_template: whether the claim is maximum month, average, cumulative, or selected period
which races were eligible or omitted
whether the result is historical backtest or forward/live publication
stake denominator: per combination or per race
whether stake sizing changed by confidence/odds
whether all published recommendations are included
whether the largest hit dominates the profit
anti_cherry_pick_rules: Freeze structures and ranking-to-ticket mapping before outcomes.
Report every eligible race including no-hit races.
Do not switch between quinella, exacta, trio, trifecta, BOX, or formation after seeing results.
If several structures are compared prospectively, keep all of them in the report rather than publishing only the winner.
A positive result driven by one jackpot must also pass leave-largest-hit-out and evidence-sufficiency checks.
